customer_question: Our Google Sheets step appends every new order as a row and fails during busy hours with 'Quota exceeded for write requests'. Is CloudFlow throttling us?
resolution: Not a CloudFlow limit (a CloudFlow rate limit would show CF-429). The error came from Google Sheets' own per-minute write quota because the workflow wrote one row per order during peaks. Recommended batching: collect orders and append many rows in one request on a schedule every 5 minutes instead of one write per order. After the change the errors stopped.
